basics.name: Erico Rahmad Darmanto
basics.label: QA / Security Engineer
basics.summary: QA / Security Engineer with a dual-degree background (S.Kom from Institut Teknologi & Bisnis STIKOM Bali and BIT from HELP University, Kuala Lumpur). I split my time between automation & manual quality engineering and offensive security — from Cypress / Selenium / Playwright suites to VAPT engagements, security code review, and incident response. Active in the Indonesian cyber-security community since 2015 — CTF problem setter, masterclass organizer, and ex-chairman of SlashRoot CTF 2.0.
